---
title: "QoL death-inclusive Markov — model fitting"
subtitle: "First-order ordinal transition models for each completed dataset"
format: html
---

- Death (state 8) is absorbing.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(rms)
library(rmsb)
library(mostr)
library(posterior)
library(arrow)
library(here)
library(yaml)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
source(here("R", "markov.R"))

indices <- seq_len(config$imputation$m_supporting)

results_dir <- here(
  "analysis", "03-quality-of-life", "03-longitudinal-with-death", "results"
)
imputation_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "imputations")
model_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "models")

dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Model specification

```{r}
#| label: model-specification
#| include: false

# 3,000 retained draws in total: per chain, 750 warmup + 750 sampling iterations.
default_warmup <- as.integer(3000L / config$markov$chains)
default_iterations <- 2L * default_warmup

retry_iterations <- config$markov$retry_iterations
retry_warmup <- retry_iterations / 2L

pcontrast_tx <- list(
  c1 = list(tx = 1),
  c2 = list(tx = 0),
  contrast = expression(c1 - c2),
  mu = 0,
  sd = 0.5
)

# rms::rcs() stays qualified: mostr recognises the inline term in this form.
model_formula <- y ~ tx + rms::rcs(week, 4) + yprev +
  ecog_fstcnt + diagnosis_code + cluster(id)
```

## Fit the models

```{r}
#| label: fit-models
#| include: false

for (index in indices) {
  model_path <- file.path(model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
  if (file.exists(model_path)) next

  data <- read_parquet(
    file.path(imputation_dir, sprintf("imputation-%02d.parquet", index))
  ) |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    mutate(
      y = as.integer(as.character(y)),
      yprev = factor(yprev, levels = 1:7),
      ecog_fstcnt = factor(ecog_fstcnt, ordered = FALSE),
      diagnosis_code = factor(diagnosis_code)
    )

  stopifnot(
    "Completed dataset is not valid for Markov model fitting" =
      !anyNA(data[all.vars(model_formula)]) &&
        !anyNA(data$id) &&
        !anyDuplicated(data[c("id", "week")]) &&
        all(data$y %in% 1:8)
  )

  dd <- datadist(data)
  options(datadist = "dd")

  fit_seed <- config$seeds$supporting + (index - 1) * 1000 + 500
  fit_attempts <- list()
  failure_reason <- NULL

  for (attempt in 1:2) {
    iterations <- if (attempt == 1L) default_iterations else retry_iterations
    warmup <- if (attempt == 1L) default_warmup else retry_warmup
    refit_reason <- if (attempt == 1L) {
      "Initial fit"
    } else {
      paste0("Initial fit failed diagnostics: ", failure_reason)
    }

    model <- blrm_markov(
      formula = model_formula,
      pcontrast = pcontrast_tx,
      ppo = ~week,
      cppo = function(y) as.numeric(as.character(y)),
      data = data,
      id_var = "id",
      time_var = "week",
      chains = config$markov$chains,
      iter = iterations,
      warmup = warmup,
      refresh = 0L,
      backend = "cmdstan",
      loo = FALSE,
      sampling.args = list(
        seed = if (attempt == 1L) fit_seed else fit_seed + 500000,
        parallel_chains = config$markov$chains
      )
    )

    diagnostics <- markov_diagnostics(model, config$diagnostics)

    # Record why the attempt failed, in words, for the audit log.
    thresholds <- config$diagnostics
    rhat <- keep(diagnostics$summary$rhat, is.finite)
    ess_bulk <- keep(diagnostics$summary$ess_bulk, is.finite)
    ess_tail <- keep(diagnostics$summary$ess_tail, is.finite)

    failure_reasons <- c(
      if (length(rhat) == 0L) {
        "R-hat was unavailable"
      } else if (max(rhat) > thresholds$max_rhat) {
        sprintf(
          "maximum R-hat %.4f exceeded %.4f",
          max(rhat),
          thresholds$max_rhat
        )
      },
      if (length(ess_bulk) == 0L) {
        "bulk ESS was unavailable"
      } else if (min(ess_bulk) < thresholds$min_ess_bulk) {
        sprintf(
          "minimum bulk ESS %.1f was below %.1f",
          min(ess_bulk),
          thresholds$min_ess_bulk
        )
      },
      if (length(ess_tail) == 0L) {
        "tail ESS was unavailable"
      } else if (min(ess_tail) < thresholds$min_ess_tail) {
        sprintf(
          "minimum tail ESS %.1f was below %.1f",
          min(ess_tail),
          thresholds$min_ess_tail
        )
      },
      if (diagnostics$divergent_transitions >
        thresholds$max_divergent_transitions) {
        paste(diagnostics$divergent_transitions, "divergent transitions")
      },
      if (diagnostics$treedepth_exceeded > thresholds$max_treedepth_exceeded) {
        paste(diagnostics$treedepth_exceeded, "treedepth exceedances")
      },
      if (is.finite(diagnostics$min_bfmi) &&
        diagnostics$min_bfmi < thresholds$min_bfmi) {
        sprintf(
          "minimum E-BFMI %.3f was below %.3f",
          diagnostics$min_bfmi,
          thresholds$min_bfmi
        )
      }
    )
    failure_reason <- if (length(failure_reasons) == 0L) {
      "None"
    } else {
      str_flatten(failure_reasons, "; ")
    }

    fit_attempts[[attempt]] <- tibble(
      imputation = index,
      attempt = attempt,
      iterations_per_chain = as.integer(iterations),
      warmup_per_chain = as.integer(warmup),
      retained_draws_per_chain = as.integer(iterations - warmup),
      refit_reason = refit_reason,
      diagnostics_passed = isTRUE(diagnostics$passed),
      diagnostic_failure_reason = failure_reason,
      r_version = as.character(getRversion()),
      mostr_version = as.character(packageVersion("mostr")),
      fit_wrapper = attr(model, "markov_fit_wrapper") %||% NA_character_,
      starting_profile_metadata_stored =
        !is.null(attr(model, "markov_starting_profile_metadata"))
    )

    # The log is written after every attempt, before the final check, so that
    # a failed or interrupted run is documented.
    write_parquet(
      list_rbind(fit_attempts),
      file.path(model_dir, sprintf("fit-attempts-%02d.parquet", index)),
      compression = "zstd"
    )

    if (isTRUE(diagnostics$passed)) break
  }

  assert_markov_diagnostics(diagnostics)

  saveRDS(model, model_path, compress = "xz")
}

options(datadist = NULL)
```
